name: DeepL Provider
description: Registers DeepL as a provider plugin for the AI module, exposing DeepL's text-translation API as the AI module's translate_text operation with the API key stored in a Key entity.
project_description: This module serves as a DeepL provider for the Drupal AI module. By installing and enabling it, you can integrate DeepL's text-translation API through the AI module's abstraction layer as the translate_text operation. It provides a configuration form for DeepL authentication (API key stored via the Key module), implements a single-model provider plugin for the AI module, and implements the AI module's TranslateTextInterface. It depends on the AI module (it is a provider for it), the Key module for API-key storage, and the official DeepL PHP client library (deeplcom/deepl-php).
